gloss: water pipe; water main; water conduit

definitions.gloss: water pipe; water main; water conduit
definitions.explanation: A pipe that carries water from one place to another, especially a large pipe in a water-supply system.

examples.japanese: {送水管|そうすいかん}が{破裂|はれつ}した。
{地下|ちか}に{太|ふと}い{送水管|そうすいかん}が{通|とお}っている。
examples.english: A thick water main runs underground.

examples.japanese: {老朽化|ろうきゅうか}した{送水管|そうすいかん}の{取|と}り{替|か}え{工事|こうじ}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Replacement work was carried out on the aging water mains.

notes:
Formed from {送水|そうすい} (water conveyance) + {管|かん} (pipe, tube). Refers to supply pipes in waterworks and buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送水管|そうすいかん}が{破裂|はれつ}する: for a water main to burst
- {送水管|そうすいかん}の{工事|こうじ}: water-main work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水道管|すいどうかん}: water pipe — the everyday word for household water pipes
- {配管|はいかん}: piping, plumbing — the pipes and the work of laying them
